limitations: Geometric frontier gain/distance scoring; no ExploRFM
Online sampling batch is smaller than paper 1000 draws to bound startup latency
Fixed-height PX4 frame; graph updated at decision/replan boundaries and asynchronously during motion
Compaction and sparse edges are project adaptations, not paper Algorithm 5
Same-batch rejection and retired-node memory are project adaptations

node_compaction.note: Zero incremental safe-cell-center coverage only; frontier/anchor protected. Path stretch checked separately.

edge_sparsification.method: local k-nearest safe edges, shortest component bridges, and bounded-detour shortcuts
edge_sparsification.note: Only existing safe edges retained. Degree may exceed k. Each dense edge has a sparse replacement within max_path_stretch.
